meta.note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry in its own words, with sources named beside each one.

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands and activities, then collectibles — and save the 100% completion push for last. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the 'Gone Fishing' story mission. Follow the on-screen objective to the end; the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It unlocks after the last chapter; complete it and the trophy pops at the credits. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' story mission. Follow the objective markers; the trophy unlocks at mission complete. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete 'The Cartel Heist' story mission. Stick to the plan the mission lays out and finish the getaway. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' story mission. The trophy unlocks when the mission wraps. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the 'Headliners' story mission. The trophy unlocks at mission complete. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the 'VCIA Takedown' story mission at the airport. The trophy unlocks at mission complete. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete 'Operation Savage Glory'. The trophy unlocks at mission complete. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible and challenge. Use the in-game stats page to find what is left, and clear the last items in the cleanup stage. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime all count. Chain them on highways and ramps around Leonida and watch the counter in the stats page. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once: shooting range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest. One attempt at each is enough. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's timing first; gold needs a clean run with few misses. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's racing line; the drone handles like a light aircraft, so brake early into turns. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road, boat and air. Each distinct race event counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating one. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Use the best rod and bait for the spot, keep the tension steady and do not let the line snap. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at any cabinet, any game. Finish a full run and the trophy pops. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final stranger mission. Work through Andy's strand in order; the last mission in the chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final stranger mission. Work through Kenton's strand in order; the last mission in the chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final stranger mission. Work through Billy's strand in order; the last mission in the chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of two to four missions; finish any eight. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final stranger mission. Work through Randy's strand in order; the last mission in the chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final stranger mission. Work through Tyrone's strand in order; the last mission in the chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Visit each marked spot and complete the session; the counter ticks per spot. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand; the unique animal appears at a marked hunting ground — track it, take the shot, and bring it back. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida; each set needs its full run of cards, so collect methodically area by area. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the app at each marked spot and complete the check-in; the counter tracks your total. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list. Any fifty count; the easiest are the driving and exploration challenges. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape. Get to four stars together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search circle until it clears. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row and keep the heat on between robberies. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct vehicle models. Variety counts: try every class, from scooters to trucks. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, then trigger Focus and chain the kills before it runs out. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Missable: during the airport sequence, take a plane and leave instead of following the scripted exit — a one-time chance. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem. Steal one from the military base or grab one from a high wanted-level response. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, and out before security responds. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault needs its own approach; escape clean after each one. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ram or block the truck, grab the cash, and lose the cops. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every named area. Drive the full map; the counter ticks as new areas appear on it. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one operation per gang across the map. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit at the beach bar and order a drink. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling there. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build your partnership rating to its top tier by completing activities with your partner. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A story choice with consequences — pick one side and live with it. Missable: the choice is one-time; the other path locks this trophy out for the playthrough, so save before the decision. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a one-time event that only triggers on a second attempt. Missable: if you pass it the first time, it will not come back in this playthrough. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A one-time strange encounter. Missable: it triggers once at a specific place and time; miss it and it is gone for the playthrough, so keep an eye out while exploring. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle into the pins at the bowling alley. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder bills in batches; the counter tracks laundered cash. Source: PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, cars and weapons — any shop spending counts toward the total. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; the trophy pops when the last deed is yours. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Add any ten vehicles you own to the app. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: On the Spot
